effect Files
    write : (string, string) => Result<int, Error>
effect Log
    info : string => Unit

// Deep in the app: no disk or logger is passed in.
writeLock lock = match perform Files.write "osprey.lock" lock
    Success _ => "installed"
    Error message => "rolled back: ${message}"
install name =
    perform Log.info "resolving ${name}"
    writeLock "${name} = 2"

// The app's edge picks the real disk and logger, once.
shipped =
    handle Files
        write path text => writeFile path text
    handle Log
        info text => print "log: ${text}"
    install "serde"
print shipped

// A test swaps in a full disk. The app code does not change.
fullDiskRollsBack () =
    handle Files
        write _ _ => Error(message = "disk full")
    handle Log
        info text => expect text "resolving serde"
    expect (install "serde") "rolled back: disk full"
test "a full disk rolls back" fullDiskRollsBack
output:
log: resolving serde
installed
ok 1 - a full disk rolls back
1..1
# tests=1 passed=1 failed=0 skipped=0
